_comment: NEMS Phase 5 — retention lifecycle for the backup Spaces bucket. Retention is enforced by the object store itself (the primary mechanism), independent of any in-cluster prune. Apply with the AWS CLI against the Spaces endpoint: aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket <BACKUP_BUCKET> --endpoint-url https://nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com --lifecycle-configuration file://spaces-lifecycle.json . Enable versioning first (see README) so NoncurrentVersionExpiration applies.
